autoOrder.description: Sorts the messages by intent rather than using the order of the array. Set it to false to preserve your order.

border.description: Draws a 2px vertical bar to the left of the wrapper, colored by the most severe intent in messages. This is the Intent Indicator from the guidelines.

messages.description: The messages to display, each with its own intent. See the table below for the shape of an item.

orderBy.description: Replaces the default severity ranking. It affects the sort order and, because it defines what counts as most severe, the border color as well, which means it still applies when autoOrder is false.

children.description: Rendered above the messages, inside the same wrapper. This is where the Input, or a group of Inputs, goes.

intent.description: Required. Sets the text color, the icon color, and this message's place in the ranking.

text.description: Required. The message copy. Long text wraps.

icon.description: Replaces the default icon. A name renders at xs; an element is rendered as given, though its fill is still overridden by the intent color.
